name: REJAL
tagline: Heritage superfoods from Malaysian forests, made for today's table

definition.summary: REJAL is SuamiSihat's heritage functional-food brand. It packs traditional Malaysian pantry staples, wild Tualang honey and single-clove garlic (bawang lanang) preserved in honey, plus a stevia sweetener, in modern, sealed packaging for everyday use.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Health-conscious Malaysian households and men looking for traditional, natural pantry products

facts.label: Channels
facts.value: SuamiSihat online store and partner marketplaces

facts.label: Packaging
facts.value: Glass jar, matte black wraparound label, gold lid with QUALITY SEAL tamper band

range.name: REJAL Bawang Lanang + Madu
range.desc: Single-clove garlic (bawang lanang) preserved in honey. Label artwork supplied for RBL25, RBL35, RBL250 and RBL500 jar sizes.

range.name: REJAL Madu Tualang
range.desc: Wild Tualang honey from Pahang. Label artwork supplied for the RBL1K jar.

range.name: REJAL Stevia
range.desc: Stevia-based zero-calorie sweetener for drinks and cooking.

definition.claimsReview: Older copy stated lab values (phenolic content, diastase number, S-allyl-cysteine increase) and cardiovascular or nitric-oxide benefits. These are health claims under the Food Regulations 1985 and must not be used until substantiated and approved. Describe ingredients, origin and use only.

positioning.statement: For Malaysian families who trust what their grandparents ate, REJAL brings wild honey and honey-preserved garlic from our own forests to the modern kitchen, sealed and traceable, without hype.

pillars.title: Rooted in heritage
pillars.text: Recipes and ingredients Malaysians already know: Tualang honey, bawang lanang, preserved the traditional way.

pillars.title: Honest sourcing
pillars.text: Say where it comes from and what is in the jar. Origin and ingredients are the story, not promises.

pillars.title: Modern standard
pillars.text: Sealed jars, clean labels and batch information. Heritage food, presented with care.

voice: Warm and proud, like a family recipe passed on
Plain-spoken: ingredients, origin, how to enjoy it
Bilingual by default (BM first, English second)
avoid: Medical or cure language (ubat, sembuh, merawat, kuat batin)
Lab numbers or percentages without approved substantiation

foundation.role: Rejal Black label and dark photography backdrops

colors.name: Rejal Black
colors.use: Label, hero backgrounds, logo on light

colors.name: Porcelain
colors.use: Light canvases for documents and web

structure.role: Heritage Gold: lid, foil, dividers and headline accents

colors.name: Heritage Gold
colors.use: Gold on black: rules, icons, large headings

accent.role: Quality Blue: the single QUALITY · NATURAL band

colors.name: Quality Blue
colors.use: One highlight band or badge per layout

pairings.use: Gold headings and rules on black
Black text on a gold badge
Text on the Quality Blue band

colorScheme.note: White text on Quality Blue fails contrast (2.7:1); the band always takes Rejal Black text. Honey amber (#E0BD6F) appears in photography only, never as a text or UI colour.

pattern.name: Tualang Honeycomb
pattern.description: Hexagonal honeycomb outline in Heritage Gold at 55% opacity on Rejal Black, with alternating solid cells. Echoes wild Tualang hives.
usage: Use on Rejal Black only, as a background band behind headings or on packaging sides
Keep text off the pattern unless it sits on a solid Rejal Black panel
Never recolour the honeycomb or run it behind the REJAL wordmark
Scale the tile so a cell is at least 24 px on screen

logos.label: REJAL wordmark (black)
logos.use: Light backgrounds. On Rejal Black, use the reversed (white) wordmark as printed on pack.

guideline.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the cap height of the wordmark on every side. Nothing (text, edges, other logos) enters this zone.
guideline.minimumSize: Digital 96 px wide; print 25 mm wide
do: Place the wordmark in black on light surfaces and in white on Rejal Black
Pair the wordmark with the QUALITY · NATURAL band only as on pack
Show the real product: honey, garlic and the sealed jar
dont: Do not use the old 'Rijal' spelling
Do not set the wordmark in gold or blue
Do not stretch, outline or add shadows to the wordmark
Do not place claims such as 'ubat' next to the logo

typography.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold (SuamiSihat master display face)
typography.body: Inter Regular / Medium for UI and long copy
typography.note: Never retype a wordmark; always place the supplied logo file.

guideline.photography: Warm light, real ingredients, honey in motion. Backdrops: Rejal Black, warm cream, sage green or natural wood.
